items.scope_note: Algorithms, Data, Impacts and Program Requirements. Networks is out of scope: it is a different pathway.

_fixture_notes: GET /api/runs, newest first. Optional set_id and course_id narrow it.
No counts here. The list is for choosing a run; GET /api/runs/{id} carries them.
Ordered by created_at, not approved_on: the newest run is usually still in review and has no approved_on.
There is no global latest run. A set against one course and the same set against another are separate work.
